name: Aoife Byrne
headline: Product Manager | Roadmapping & User-Centric Product Strategy
summary: Product Manager with 4 years of experience delivering user-centric digital products across fintech and SaaS environments. Skilled in roadmapping, user research, and cross-functional collaboration to translate customer needs into actionable product features. Proven ability to manage backlogs, prioritize initiatives, and work closely with engineering and design teams to ship impactful releases.

responsibilities: Own product roadmap for a B2B SaaS platform serving mid-market clients
Conduct user research interviews and usability testing to inform feature prioritization
Manage sprint backlogs and coordinate with engineering teams using Jira
Collaborate with design team to refine user flows and wireframes
Present quarterly roadmap updates to stakeholders and leadership
Supported senior PM in defining product requirements and user stories
Assisted in running customer interviews and synthesizing research findings
Maintained product backlog and tracked sprint progress in Jira
Coordinated with QA team to validate feature releases
Analyzed user feedback to identify improvement opportunities
